stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]哪些活动属于负面新闻和声誉风险的不良媒体筛查？(选择三项.)

options.A: 通过反馈和调查分析客户情绪
options.B: 识别与犯罪活动或制裁有关的个人或实体

options.D: 检索公开发布的新闻报道和监管警报
options.E: 监测个人或实体信用评分的变化

stem_en: Which activities are part of adverse media screening for negative news and reputational risks? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Analyzing customer sentiment through feedback and surveys.
options_en.B: Identifying individuals or entities linked to criminal activities or sanctions.
options_en.C: Periodically monitoring regulatory updates and enforcement actions for associated entities.
options_en.D: Scanning publicly available news articles and regulatory alerts.
options_en.E: Monitoring changes in credit scores of individuals or entities.
